items.title: Hackers exploit GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers, KVM devices
items.snippet: GL.iNet has confirmed that hackers exploited a vulnerability in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices, with some affected users reporting backdoors and reverse shells giving remote access to infected devices. [...]
items.summary: GL.iNet says hackers exploited a flaw in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices; some users report backdoors and reverse shells.
items.why: Check GL.iNet remote management exposure and affected devices for malware, backdoors, or reverse shells.

items.title: Cleverbridge warns hackers stole credit card numbers, CVVs in data breach
items.snippet: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge is warning that hackers breached its systems and stole customers' payment card information, including credit card numbers and CVV security codes. [...]
items.summary: Cleverbridge warns that hackers breached its systems and stole customers' payment card numbers and CVV security codes.
items.why: Check payment systems and breach notices, and review card data exposure and related transactions.

items.title: Signal to block Siri, Gemini AI from capturing chats on iOS, Android
items.snippet: Signal has announced new protections that block screenshots on iOS 27 and prevent AI assistants from capturing conversations on supported Android devices. [...]
items.summary: Signal says new protections block screenshots on iOS 27 and prevent AI assistants from capturing conversations on supported Android devices.
items.why: Review device support and privacy settings if your organization relies on Signal for sensitive conversations.

items.title: OpenRouter Drops 3 Providers After Researchers Catch Months of Prompt Theft at AI Hosting Firms
items.snippet: Attackers stole data from inside three AI inference providers for months, and none of the three knew until researchers told them, the industrial cybersecurity company Dragos said this week. Some of the stolen requests were flagged as Zero Data Retention, the setting that is supposed to mean a prompt is never stored. Op
items.summary: Dragos says attackers stole data from inside three AI inference providers for months; the providers learned of the theft from researchers.
items.why: Review data-retention claims and access controls at AI inference providers.

items.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
items.snippet: A now-patched flaw in Ghostscript allows a crafted file to escape the program's security sandbox and run commands on the server that processes it. Ghostscript is the interpreter that many Linux servers use to convert uploaded PDFs, PostScript files, and images into other formats, often without the application calling i
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated a now-patched Ghostscript flaw that let crafted files escape the sandbox and run commands on servers processing them.
items.why: Check Ghostscript versions and isolate services that process uploaded files.

items.why: Review Optimizely exposure and investigate suspicious activity associated with the vulnerability.

items.title: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
items.snippet: Rackspace warned customers that hackers breached its Rackspace Spot cloud platform using compromised credentials, allowing them to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters. [...]
items.summary: Rackspace warned customers that compromised credentials were used to breach Rackspace Spot, deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters.
items.why: Check cloud credentials and Kubernetes secrets for unauthorized access or workloads.

items.title: FBI Investigating Apparent Hack of Its Key National Criminal Justice Database, AP Source Says
items.snippet: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of a national law enforcement database that it maintains. The post FBI Investigating Apparent Hack of Its Key National Criminal Justice Database, AP Source Says appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of a national law enforcement database it maintains, according to the report.

items.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
items.snippet: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information. [...]
items.summary: Microsoft says attackers exploited a vulnerability in Entra Connect Health to access administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.
items.why: Review Entra Connect Health access and tenant configuration, and investigate for unauthorized access.

items.title: BADBOX botnet returns with record-breaking 40 billion daily ad requests
items.snippet: The BADBOX malware found in a broad range of generic Android TV boxes has returned to large-scale ad-fraud operations following last year's disruptions. [...]
items.summary: BADBOX malware has returned to large-scale ad-fraud operations on generic Android TV boxes, BleepingComputer reports.
items.why: Check Android TV devices for BADBOX malware and unusual ad-request activity.

items.summary: The UK has joined 10 other nations in NATO's STARLIFT initiative to create a network of flexible satellite launch services.

items.snippet: “What the hell is happening? Why is this being done? What are the consequences and the costs? And what does it say about our reliability in the future?” Sen. Chris Coons asked.

items.title: Defence Secretary meets President Zelensky and Minister Khmara in Kyiv as UK deepens industrial support for Ukraine
items.snippet: Defence Secretary meets President Zelenskyy in Kyiv as new agreements strengthen UK industrial support for Ukraine and expand drone production
items.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence says new agreements deepen industrial support for Ukraine and expand drone production.
items.why: Expanded drone production is relevant to the industrial capacity supporting Ukraine.

items.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
items.snippet: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.
items.summary: Officials say an explosion on a Russian ship at a Libya port was caused by a suspected drone attack. Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.
items.why: The reported incident highlights the strategic relevance of port stops and maritime routes.

items.title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes
items.snippet: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford reports from the scene of a collapsed residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region.
items.summary: The BBC reports from the scene of a collapsed residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region as Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes.
items.why: The report concerns the civilian impact and local consequences of strikes in the Kyiv region.

items.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
items.snippet: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday. Kyiv has yet to comment.
items.summary: Finnish defence forces say Ukraine was likely behind a drone attack on a Russia-bound ship in the Gulf of Finland.
items.why: The reported attack highlights the operational reach of drones around shipping routes.

items.title: Civilians killed in RSF drone strikes in Sudan

items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that drone strikes by Sudan’s Rapid Support Forces killed civilians and damaged buildings.
items.why: Drone use and reported harm to civilians are relevant to assessing conflict impacts.

items.title: Russian vessel hit by suspected Ukrainian drone at Libya’s Benghazi port
items.snippet: There was no immediate reaction from Russia, and no one has claimed responsibility for the suspected attack.
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that a Russian vessel was hit by a suspected Ukrainian drone at Libya’s Benghazi port. Russia did not immediately react, and no one claimed responsibility.
items.why: The reported strike puts maritime activity at Benghazi port in focus, while responsibility remains unclaimed.

items.title: Drone attacks kill four near Sudan’s capital, damage UN building
items.snippet: The Rapid Support Forces are blamed as drones reportedly hit UN and government buildings, as well as Khartoum's airport.
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that drone attacks killed four near Sudan’s capital and damaged UN and government buildings, as well as Khartoum's airport. The Rapid Support Forces are blamed.
items.why: The reported damage to a UN building and airport has humanitarian and operational relevance.

items.title: Zelenskyy urges US to release Patriot missiles as Russia kills 7 in Ukraine

items.summary: Zelenskyy urges the US to release Patriot missiles. The report says Russian attacks killed at least six people near Kyiv and overnight shelling killed one in Zaporizhzhia.
items.why: The missile request and reported strikes relate to air defence and civilian impacts in Ukraine.

items.title: Sudan: Drones hit UN building, residential area in Khartoum
items.snippet: The drones targeted Khartoum, damaging a UN building in the residential area. The UN agency deemed it unacceptable that humanitarian workers were exposed to such danger.
items.summary: DW reports that drones targeted Khartoum, damaging a UN building in a residential area. The UN agency said exposing humanitarian workers to such danger was unacceptable.
items.why: The incident underscores risks to humanitarian workers and facilities in a residential area.

learn.explainer: A service that lets users manage devices over a network. In the GL.iNet report, hackers exploited a vulnerability in this service to install malware on routers and KVM devices.
An uncrewed aircraft. The reports describe suspected or reported drone attacks on a ship and strikes affecting buildings and civilians.
A place on a coast where ships can stop. The Libya report says the vessel stopped for fuel and supplies at a port on its way back to Russia.

analysis.headline: Cyber exposure and reported strikes put access and impact in focus
paragraphs: The stories describe risks across digital systems and physical infrastructure. GL.iNet says hackers exploited cloud remote management to install malware, while reports from Libya describe a suspected drone attack on a Russian ship at port. Both accounts concern access to systems or assets, though the methods and settings differ.

Other reports focus on consequences: a collapsed residential building in Ukraine, civilian deaths and damaged buildings in Sudan, and a Cleverbridge breach involving payment card details. These accounts suggest defenders and analysts should distinguish confirmed statements from suspected attribution, and track both operational and civilian impacts.

For defenders, the GL.iNet report makes remote management and device checks relevant; the Cleverbridge warning makes payment data exposure worth reviewing. Analysts may watch for further reporting on the Libya ship incident and the reported strikes, while noting that some responsibility remains suspected or unclaimed.
takeaways: Check remote management exposure and devices for reported malware and backdoors.
Treat reported attack attribution carefully when officials describe it as suspected.
Track both infrastructure damage and reported civilian impacts.
